role: Pure routing core: given a value snapshot of mode, selected provider/model, voice flag and per-provider state, decides which provider/model/tier answers a turn plus log lines; also the failure-fallback policy and the PickedModelFailure error.
types: TurnRouter.ProviderState: struct — availability/consent/tools/default model per provider
TurnRouter.TierStage: struct — impure tier-proposal results supplied by shell
TurnRouter.Decision: struct — routed provider/model/tier + log lines
PickedModelFailure: struct (LocalizedError) — error when the picked model fails and no fallback is allowed
toplevel: No stored state; all value types. Covered by EmuquTests/TurnRouterTests.swift.

units.does: Returns a copy of Inputs with tierStage replaced.
Returns preTierDecision if it yields an early decision, else tierDecision. Called by AssistantTurnRouter.resolveProviderForThisTurn (AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:42).

branches.effect: true: return early decision; false: return tierDecision

units.does: True when preTierDecision returns nil (turn must go through the tier stage).
Early decision: any non-Apple selected provider or Manual mode → user's pick (no tier); Apple + voice → appleVoiceBypass; Apple + typed non-Manual → nil (tier stage).

branches.effect: true: returns userPick (tier nil, no logs); false: continue
true: returns appleVoiceBypass; false: returns nil

units.does: Apple + voice: routes to the first available consented non-Apple cloud with its default/first model and a log line; if none (or it has no model), stays on the user's Apple pick with a log line.

branches.cond: a consented cloud exists AND it has a default/first model
branches.effect: true: Decision(cloud, model, tier nil); false: userPick with 'no consented cloud' log

units.does: Tier stage: without a TierStage returns user pick; downgrades Deep→Auto when Tier-3 cap reached; looks up the tier mapping (missing → user pick with tier); logs mapping/collapse; applies action-intent override if applicable; else returns the mapping's provider/model.

branches.effect: true: log + finalTier = .auto; false: keep proposed tier
false: userPick(tier: finalTier) (unreachable by construction per comment 228-232); true: continue
true: 'collapsed to' log; false: 'tier → provider:model' log
true: Decision with override provider/model; false: Decision with mapping provider/model

units.does: Returns a Decision with the selected provider and model and the given tier/log lines.
If the mapped provider lacks tool support and the message requires tools, returns the first consented cloud and its default model (appending a log line); else nil.

branches.effect: defaults to true (no override) when the mapped provider has no ProviderState in the snapshot

branches.cond: !supportsTools AND messageRequiresTools AND consented cloud with model exists
branches.effect: true: log + return (cloudID, model); false: nil

units.does: Returns the first provider id in providerOrder that is not Apple, has a ProviderState, and is available and consented; nil if none.

branches.effect: false: skip id; true: return isAvailable && isConsented as the match predicate

units.does: Static: maps (mode, selected provider) to the allowed failure fallback: non-Apple selection → .none; Apple + Manual → .none; Apple + Quick → .onDeviceOnly; Apple + Auto/Deep → .anyAccepted. Used by AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:665.
Static: filters a fallback chain by policy: .none → empty, .onDeviceOnly → only Apple entries, .anyAccepted → whole chain.

branches.effect: returns chain entries whose provider id is .apple

units.does: Localized message naming the failed provider and the reason (the underlying AIProviderError's localizedDescription, which for a LocalizedError is its errorDescription), stating Flo did not hand the question to another model.
units.entry: LocalizedError witness read when the error is surfaced (AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:672)
